title: Machine language tuple
statement: Given a finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over the Boolean alphabet, define a function on the four indices $0,1,2,3$ whose values, in order, are the language of valid input lengths, the language of initial configurations of $N$, the language of valid single-step transitions of $N$, and the language of accepting configurations of $N$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
